cases.title: Licensed user opens Meeting Notes list
cases.what: A user with thinkspace-thought license opens the Thought module and sees the meeting list layout.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in.
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/thought.
3. Confirm Meeting Notes heading and Create meeting button.
4. Confirm page is not redirected to /403.

cases.title: Navigate to Meeting intelligence dashboard
cases.what: User opens the analytics dashboard from the list header.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/thought.
2. Click Intelligence.
3. Verify Meeting intelligence heading and stats or loading state.

cases.title: Guest is redirected to login
cases.what: Unauthenticated user cannot access Thought list.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/thought without session.
2. Verify redirect to /login.

cases.workflowStep: Create meeting modal → title → Create meeting → workspace
cases.title: Create meeting and open workspace
cases.what: User creates a meeting with title and is navigated to the mind-map workspace.
cases.steps:
1. Click Create meeting.
2. Fill meeting title.
3. Submit Create meeting.
4. Verify URL has ?meeting= and canvas loads.
cases.expected: Meeting is created and workspace opens.

cases.title: Create meeting with date and agenda
cases.what: Optional fields are saved when creating a meeting.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Fill title, date, agenda.
3. Create meeting.
4. Verify via API getMeetingNote.

cases.title: Cancel create does not navigate
cases.what: Cancel closes modal without opening workspace.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Fill title.
3. Click Cancel.
4. Verify still on list page.

cases.title: Empty title blocks create
cases.what: HTML required validation prevents empty meeting title.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Leave title empty.
3. Attempt submit.
validationPoints: Form validation prevents submit or handler returns early
cases.expected: Meeting is not created without title.

cases.title: Filter meetings by search query
cases.what: Client-side search filters meeting cards by title.
cases.steps:
1. Create a uniquely titled meeting.
2. Return to list.
3. Search unique title.
4. Verify card visible.
5. Search nonsense → no matches message.
validationPoints: No meetings match message for bad query

cases.title: Set RSVP from list card
cases.what: User can set RSVP status from the meeting list.
cases.steps:
1. On list card click accepted.
2. Verify API accepts without error.

cases.title: Preview action logs from list
cases.what: Action Logs modal shows ledger or empty state.
cases.steps:
1. Click Action Logs on a card.
2. Verify modal title and empty or populated state.

cases.title: Preview comment logs from list
cases.what: Comments modal shows ledger or empty state.
cases.steps:
1. Click Comments on a card.
2. Verify modal and empty or comment rows.

cases.workflowStep: Open workspace via card Open link
cases.title: Open existing meeting workspace
cases.what: User opens workspace from list card and sees canvas.
cases.steps:
1. Create meeting.
2. Return to list.
3. Click Open.
4. Verify workspace loads.

cases.workflowStep: Add child node via fast button
cases.title: Add child node on canvas
cases.what: User adds a child node from the central topic.
cases.steps:
1. Open workspace.
2. Click Add child node on central node.
3. Verify new node appears.

cases.workflowStep: Context menu → Create child / Edit label / Delete
cases.title: Context menu node operations
cases.what: Right-click menu supports create, edit, delete on non-central nodes.
cases.steps:
1. Add child node.
2. Right-click child → Edit label → type new label.
3. Add sibling via context menu.
4. Delete node with confirm.

cases.title: Undo and redo canvas changes
cases.what: Undo/redo buttons revert canvas edits.
cases.steps:
1. Add node.
2. Click Undo → node removed.
3. Click Redo → node restored.

cases.title: Search and highlight nodes
cases.what: Node search input filters/highlights matching nodes.
cases.steps:
1. Create node with unique label.
2. Type label in Search nodes.
3. Verify node remains/findable.

cases.title: Canvas zoom controls
cases.what: Zoom buttons adjust canvas viewport.
cases.steps:
1. Click Zoom in.
2. Click Zoom out.
3. Click Fit canvas.

cases.title: Switch dock tools and side panel
cases.what: Left dock toggles canvas, logs panel, and AI summary.
cases.steps:
1. Click Comment & Action Logs.
2. Verify logs tablist.
3. Click AI Summary.
4. Click Canvas.

cases.title: Open contributors panel
cases.what: Manager can open contributors panel from header.
cases.steps:
1. Click Manage contributors.
2. Verify contributors panel content.

cases.title: Add comment on canvas node
cases.what: User adds a comment via context menu cloud editor.
cases.steps:
1. Right-click node → Add comment.
2. Type comment.
3. Save.
4. Verify comment bubble on node.

cases.workflowStep: Context menu → Create action → modal → submit
cases.title: Create action from canvas node
cases.what: User creates a Specific action linked to Thought meeting.
cases.steps:
1. Right-click node → Create action.
2. Select assignee, confirm title.
3. Create Action.
4. Verify in Actions tab and Thinkspace tasks API.

cases.title: Action modal requires assignee
cases.what: Submit without assignee shows validation error.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create action modal.
2. Clear assignee.
3. Submit.
4. Verify error message.
validationPoints: Select at least one assignee error
cases.expected: Action is not created without assignee.

cases.title: View actions in logs panel
cases.what: Created actions appear in Actions tab of logs panel.
cases.steps:
1. Create action from node.
2. Open Logs dock → Actions tab.
3. Verify action row.

cases.title: View comments in logs panel
cases.what: Saved comments appear in Comments tab.
cases.steps:
1. Add comment on node.
2. Open Logs → Comments tab.
3. Verify comment row.

cases.title: Upload meeting material file
cases.what: User uploads a file to meeting materials.
cases.steps:
1. Open Logs → Materials tab.
2. Add meeting material → Upload new file.
3. Complete upload flow.
4. Verify file in list.

cases.workflowStep: Header Export menu → JSON / comment log
cases.title: Export JSON and comment log
cases.what: Export menu downloads JSON and text files.
cases.steps:
1. Open Export menu.
2. Export as JSON → download event.
3. Export comment log (text) → download event.

cases.workflowStep: AI Summary dock → live summary visible
cases.title: AI summary panel shows live summary
cases.what: AI Summary dock displays derived summary text.
cases.steps:
1. Open AI Summary dock.
2. Verify summary content area.
3. Enhance with AI button visible.

cases.title: Analytics stats cards render
cases.what: Meeting intelligence dashboard shows stat cards.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to analytics.
2. Verify Total meetings and related cards.

cases.title: Global search returns results or empty
cases.what: Analytics global search submits and shows results list.
cases.steps:
1. Enter search term.
2. Click Search.
3. Verify results list or empty.

cases.title: Missing meeting param redirects to list
cases.what: Workspace URL without ?meeting= redirects to list.
cases.steps:
1. Navigate to /thinkspace/thought/workspace.
2. Verify redirect to list.

cases.title: Navigate back to Action Master
cases.what: Back link returns user to /thinkspace/task.
cases.steps:
1. Open workspace.
2. Click Actions & agendas.
3. Verify /thinkspace/task.

cases.title: Delete uploaded material
cases.what: User can delete an uploaded material with confirm.
cases.steps:
1. Upload file.
2. Select file.
3. Delete with confirm.
4. Verify removed from list.

cases.workflowStep: Contributor combobox → search → pick from listbox
cases.title: Add contributor from directory search
cases.what: User searches directory and adds a contributor chip in create modal.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Focus Search people to add.
3. Type search query.
4. Pick user from listbox.
5. Verify contributor chip appears.
cases.expected: Contributor is added to meeting form.

cases.title: Set contributor access role
cases.what: User changes collaborator access between Viewer and Editor on create form.
cases.steps:
1. Add contributor.
2. Open access select on chip.
3. Choose Editor.
4. Verify select value is editor.

cases.uiLocation: AttendeePicker — Guest name, Email, Guest button
cases.title: Add guest contributor on create form
cases.what: User adds an external guest via compact guest form.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Fill Guest name and Email.
3. Click Guest.
4. Verify guest chip appears.
validationPoints: Guest name shown in contributors list
